context: A couple browses a furniture store, weighing each item carefully
purpose: Teach: 家具/流れる/居る/人形/じっくり/見つめ/やる気/奇跡

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 見て、この家具屋さん、北欧家具がたくさんあるよ。
lines.en: Look, this furniture store has so much Scandinavian furniture.
lines.style: Soft excited tone, drawing partner's attention warmly

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 本当だな。じっくり見て回ろうか。一日中ここに居るのも悪くないな。
lines.en: You're right. Let's look around carefully. Staying here all day wouldn't be bad.
lines.style: Calm fatherly tone, relaxed and patient pace

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あのソファ、すごく素敵…座ってみたら時間が流れるのを忘れそう。
lines.en: That sofa is so lovely... if I sat on it I'd forget time passing.
lines.style: Dreamy romantic delivery, slightly breathy and admiring

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 値段を見つめてため息が出るよ。でも質はかなり良さそうだ。
lines.en: I stare at the price tag and sigh. But the quality looks excellent.
lines.style: Wry resigned humor, gentle teasing undertone

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ねえ、棚の上のあの木の人形、可愛くない?玄関に飾りたい。
lines.en: Hey, that wooden doll on the shelf, isn't it cute? I want to put it in the entryway.
lines.style: Playful coaxing energy, light and affectionate

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ふむ、悪くない。今日は珍しく君の選ぶ物にやる気を感じるな。
lines.en: Hmm, not bad. Unusually, I feel motivated about what you're picking today.
lines.style: Amused approving chuckle, warm spousal banter

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 予算内で全部揃ったら奇跡だよね。もう一周ゆっくり考えよう。
lines.en: It'd be a miracle if everything fit our budget. Let's walk around once more slowly.
lines.style: Hopeful laughing tone, suggesting another careful loop
